📍 𝗞𝗶𝗹𝗸𝗲𝗻𝗻𝘆, 𝗜𝗿𝗲𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱
📅 𝟮𝟳–𝟮𝟵𝘁𝗵 𝗢𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗯𝗲𝗿 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲
 𝗜𝗻-𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗼𝗻 | 𝗙𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗰𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗴𝗲

The European Rural Mobility Network (ERMN) is pleased to announce three days of discussion, exchange and learning on the future of rural mobility in Europe, taking place in 𝗞𝗶𝗹𝗸𝗲𝗻𝗻𝘆, 𝗜𝗿𝗲𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱, 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝟮𝟳 𝘁𝗼 𝟮𝟵𝘁𝗵 𝗢𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗯𝗲𝗿 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲.

The programme will bring together policymakers, local authorities, mobility agencies, rural development stakeholders and research organisations to explore how rural mobility can contribute to greater equity, cohesion and sustainability across Europe.

The 𝘁𝗵𝗿𝗲𝗲-𝗱𝗮𝘆 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗴𝗿𝗮𝗺𝗺𝗲 will include:

🔹 𝟮𝟳𝘁𝗵 𝗢𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗯𝗲𝗿 – 𝗘𝗥𝗠𝗡 𝗦𝗶𝗱𝗲 𝗘𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘁
 A dedicated afternoon of interactive workshops, providing space to exchange practical experiences and explore different aspects of rural mobility.

🔹 𝟮𝟴𝘁𝗵 𝗢𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗯𝗲𝗿 – 𝗘𝘂𝗿𝗼𝗽𝗲𝗮𝗻 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗳𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲
 “Europe’s Rural Mobility Future: Setting Standards”, promoted by Renew Europe and Cynthia Ní Mhurchú MEP in association with Kilkenny LEADER Partnership and the ERMN-European Rural Mobility Network.
The conference will focus on the growing concept of service standards for rural mobility, exploring how they can support European environmental, social and rural development goals.

🔹 𝟮𝟵𝘁𝗵 𝗢𝘤𝘁𝗼𝗯𝗲𝗿 – 𝗦𝗶𝘁𝗲 𝗩𝗶𝘀𝗶𝘁𝘀
 An opportunity to discover local initiatives and mobility solutions in and around Kilkenny.

If you are working on rural mobility, rural development, transport policy or related fields, 𝘀𝗮𝘃𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗿𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗶𝗻 𝗷𝗼𝗶𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘂𝘀!

𝗧𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗸 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘆𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝘄𝗵𝗼 𝗷𝗼𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗱 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝘄𝗲𝗯𝗶𝗻𝗮𝗿 𝗼𝗻 “𝗙𝗶𝗻𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗥𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗠𝗼𝘃𝗲: 𝗦𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗙𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗥𝘂𝗿𝗮𝗹 𝗠𝗼𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆!”

On July 15th, the European Rural Mobility Network (ERMN) organised an online event dedicated to exploring sustainable funding and financing solutions for rural mobility across Europe.
The session, moderated by Maria Siti, opened with an introduction to the main challenges faced by rural communities in accessing funding opportunities and developing mobility solutions, presented by Andrea Lorenzini.

During the webinar, participants had the opportunity to learn from three inspiring practice case studies presented by:
🔹Dominik Janik, CITYA- Czechia
🔹Miguel Calado, Transport Authority of the Alentejo Litoral- Portugal
🔹Vassilis Mizaras, CERTH- Greece
The discussion focused on practical funding mechanisms, long-term financing strategies, and ways to engage public and private actors in supporting rural mobility services.

At the end, Matilde Vezzani and Eleonora Ercoli presented the latest network updates, upcoming activities and opportunities of interactions.

🚀 𝗥𝗲𝗮𝗱𝘆 𝘁𝗼 𝘀𝗵𝗮𝗽𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗳𝘂𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗿𝘂𝗿𝗮𝗹 𝗺𝗼𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝘁𝗼𝗴𝗲𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗿 ?
The webinar offered a deep dive into the unique advantages of 𝗷𝗼𝗶𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗘𝗥𝗠𝗡 𝗠𝗲𝗺𝗯𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽. If your organisation wants to collaborate with peers and experts and drive real change across Europe, we want you on board!

✅ Take the first step and let us know your interest by filling out the ERMN 𝙀𝙭𝙥𝙧𝙚𝙨𝙨𝙞𝙤𝙣 𝙤𝙛 𝙄𝙣𝙩𝙚𝙧𝙚𝙨𝙩 𝙁𝙤𝙧𝙢 https://lnkd.in/exQmuzVE.

𝗟𝗲𝘁’𝘀 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗻𝗲𝗰𝘁 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗴𝗿𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗻𝗲𝘁𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸!

A big thank you to all speakers for sharing their valuable experiences and practical insights, and to all participants for contributing to an engaging discussion!

📄 The presentations and materials from the webinar will soon be available on our website https://lnkd.in/eAiB-aJb

Thank you to everyone who joined our webinar on Demand Responsive Transport (DRT)!

On March 10th, the European Rural Mobility Network (ERMN) organised an online meeting dedicated to exploring how DRT solutions can improve mobility and accessibility in rural areas.

The session, moderated by Maria Siti, opened with an introductory presentation by Andrea Lorenzini, who provided an overview of on-demand services and their role in addressing rural mobility challenges.
During the webinar, participants had the opportunity to learn from three inspiring case studies presented by:

🔹 Karl-Heinz Shoon, Germany-Kusel District
🔹 Sarah Togher & John Doyle, Ireland-TFI Local Link Mayo
🔹 Elisa Tesser, Italy-MoM - Mobilità di Marca

A big thank you to our speakers for sharing their valuable experiences and practical insights, and to all participants for contributing to an engaging discussion!

We would also like to thank Matilde Vezzani and Eleonora Ercoli for sharing the Key takeaways and presenting the next steps and initiatives of the European Rural Mobility Network.

📄 The presentations and materials from the webinar are now available on our website:
👉 https://lnkd.in/dDyrHFXc

Stay connected with ERMN for more opportunities to exchange knowledge and explore innovative solutions for rural mobility across Europe.

ERMN-European Rural Mobility Network
121 abonnés
We are pleased to introduce the European Rural Mobility Network (ERMN).
ERMN was created to connect people, ideas and experiences working towards a fairer and more accessible mobility future for rural Europe.
Officially established in July 2025 as a non-profit association under Belgian law, ERMN brings together municipalities, experts and stakeholders committed to strengthening transport services in rural areas.

🚍 Our mission is simple but ambitious:
to promote, exchange and disseminate knowledge, good practices and innovative solutions that improve mobility and accessibility across rural territories.
Through workshops, knowledge-sharing initiatives and capacity-building activities, ERMN supports local authorities and communities in overcoming mobility challenges, equipping them with practical tools and expertise.
At the same time, the network acts as a collective voice, engaging with European and national institutions to advocate for supportive policies, strategies and funding frameworks.

🤝 ERMN is a growing community — open to municipalities, organisations and “friends” who believe mobility is a key driver of inclusion, cohesion and opportunity.

👉 Follow our page to stay connected, exchange ideas and help shape the future of rural mobility in Europe.
